settingsAlerting.title: Alert integrations
settingsAlerting.description: Turn observability alerts into deduplicated tickets — one error becomes one ticket, however many times it fires.
settingsAlerting.secretOnce: Store these now — the signing secret is shown only once.
settingsAlerting.attachDestination: Attach the destination to every alert.
settingsAlerting.rulesHint: First matching rule wins. Leave a field blank to match anything.
settingsAlerting.noRules: No rules — all alerts use the default form and severity-based priority.
